title_sq: Tek Kryqezimi I 21 Dhjetorit ,Shitet Apartament 2+1 Dhe Garsoniere Te Investuar Dhe Te Ndare Per Airbnb!
description_sq: Tek Kryqezimi i 21 Dhjetorit ,Shitet Apartament 2+1 dhe Garsoniere te Investuar Dhe te Ndare Per Airbnb! Apartamentet kane nje siperfaqe neto 105m2 dhe ndodhen ne katin e 4 me pamje nga kryqezimi dhe rruga Muhamet Gjollesha. Prona eshte konceptuar, projektuar dhe e rikonstruktuar totalisht me punime dhe arredim cilesor ne gjendje pune si biznes ne dy apartamente ngjitur me njeri tjetrin per qira ditore . Lokacioni i prones ne kryqezimin e 21 Dhjetorit ne nje distance me te vogel se 1 km nga qendra e Tiranes, buze Unazes dhe me orientim mjaft te favorshem ne te 3 drejtimet Lindje-Jug-Perendim, me nje organizim te hapesires shum funksionale per te dy njesite si me poshte eshte nje mundesi IDEALE INVESTIMI per qira ditore. Studio perbehet nga dhome ndenje me divan 2sh dhe gjumi me krevat matrimonial mural e plotesuar me kendin e dedikuar per post pune dhe ambient ngrenie. Kuzhine e vecuar e kompletuar me te gjithe pajisjet dhe hapesirat e nevojshme, me ndricim natyral dhe ajrim natyral dhe aspirim. Tualet mjaft i bollshem dhe i kompletuar me te gjitha pajisjet e nevojshme perfshire dhe lavatrice dhe mundesi vendosje tharese mbi lavatricen. Apartamenti 2+1 perbehet nga dhome ndenje me guzhine me dalje ne ballkonin perimetral qe ofron mundesine e nje pamje te lire dhe relaksuese ne hapesirat e gjelberta te shkolles perbri. Dhome matrimoniale me garderobe te hapur, me ndricim pergjate gjithe dites e orientuar ne Lindje-Jug dhe me dalje ne ballkonin perimetral. Dhome gjumi femijesh e kompletuar me dy krevate, garderobe te bollshme dhe post pune. Tualet i bollshem dhe i kompletuar me te gjitha pajisjet e nevojshme perfshire dhe lavatrice dhe mundesi vendosje tharese mbi lavatricen. Per menaxhimin e njesive si te ndara apo te perbashketa per aksesin si dhe eficiencen energjitike ne perdorimin nga klientet per AirBnB & Booking, porta kryesore per secilen njesi jane te pajisura me akses nepermjete kodit dhe karte aksesi qe menaxhon kyqjen/ckyqjen e energjise. Investimi ne kete prone perllogaritur mbi te ardhurat vjetore 22 k EUR pergjate vitit 2024 dhe kostot optimale ne operimin dhe mirembajten ne saje te investimit te kryer, siguron nje kthim investimi me nje norme shume te larte (10 - 12 vite). Zhvillimi i vrullshem ne Tirane me ndertimet e reja ne permbushje te kerkeses ne zonat ne afersi te qendres prane te gjithe faciliteteve te nevojshme, perben nje oportunitet ne te ardhmen per te perfituar siperfaqe te konsiderueshme ne objekt te ri residencial/komercial qe mund te ndertohet ne siperfaqe takuese te truallit te kesaj prone. Prona eshte ne perdorim si biznes per qira ditore , me nje performance te shkelqyer vleresuar nga Booking me TRAVELLER REVIEW AWARDS 2025! Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At the intersection of December 21, 2+1 apartment and studio apartment for sale, invested and separated for Airbnb!
description_en: At the Crossroads of December 21, 2+1 Apartment and Studio Invested and Separated for Airbnb! The apartments have a net area of ​​105m2 and are located on the 4th floor overlooking the intersection and Muhamet Gjollesha street. The property has been conceived, designed and completely reconstructed with quality work and furnishings in working condition as a business in two apartments next to each other for daily rent. The location of the property at the intersection of 21 December at a distance of less than 1 km from the center of Tirana, the edge of the Ring Road and with a very favorable orientation in the 3 directions East-South-West, with a very functional space organization for both units as below is an IDEAL INVESTMENT opportunity for daily rent. The studio consists of a living room with a 2-bed sofa and a bedroom with a matrimonial bed, complete with a corner dedicated to a work station and a dining area. Separate kitchen complete with all necessary equipment and spaces, with natural lighting and natural ventilation and aspiration. The toilet is quite spacious and complete with all the necessary equipment, including a washing machine and the possibility of placing a dryer on top of the washing machine. The 2+1 apartment consists of a living room with a kitchen with access to the perimeter balcony that offers the possibility of a free and relaxing view of the green spaces of the school. Matrimonial room with open wardrobe, with lighting throughout the day, oriented to the East-South and with access to the perimeter balcony. Children's bedroom complete with two beds, spacious wardrobe and work station. The toilet is spacious and complete with all the necessary equipment, including a washing machine and the possibility of placing a dryer on top of the washing machine. For the management of units as separate or joint for access as well as energy efficiency in the use by customers for AirBnB & Booking, the main gate for each unit is equipped with access through the code and access card that manages the power on/off. The investment in this property calculated on the annual income of 22 k EUR during the year 2024 and the optimal costs in operation and maintenance thanks to the investment made, ensures a return on investment with a very high rate (10 - 12 years). The rapid development in Tirana with the new constructions in fulfillment of the demand in the areas close to the center near all the necessary facilities, constitutes an opportunity in the future to benefit from a considerable area in a new residential/commercial facility that can be built on the corresponding area of ​​the plot of this property. The property is used as a business for daily rent, with an excellent performance evaluated by Booking with TRAVELER REVIEW AWARDS 2025! The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
